Maya (Product): Heads up: Small preview release tonight for 'Private Config Guard' — a policy enforcement layer for onprem/VPC installs. :lock:
Maya (Product): What it does: optional admission checks on config pushes (disallowed sysctl, open ports, privileged mounts), signed config snapshots, and a 'policy drift' alert in the Console.
Liam - Security: Important: policy checks run locally by default. Remote policy eval to policy.redwood.ai is opt-in for central teams. No model data leaves the host.
Priya (CS): Does this affect customer upgrades?
Maya (Product): If customers enable Guard they get a preflight check during agent upgrade. Failures are non-blocking by default but can be set to block for strict installs.
Liam - Security: Requirements: agent v3.2+, policy files (YAML) managed via Console or Gitops. Support for enterprise SSO and RBAC for who can change policies.
Priya (CS): Can CSMs preview the alert emails?
Maya (Product): Yes — there's a template and a demo webhook. We'll send CSMs the preview pack after deploy.
deploy-bot: deploy started: preview/private-config-guard -> 3340012370
Maya (Product): Rollout plan: tonight -> internal tenants; week+ -> invited customers; GA after feedback (~4 weeks). Preview is enabled per-tenant and free.
Priya (CS): Nominating two customers for preview who asked for stricter config controls. I'll file intake form.
Liam - Security: Action: security to run a quick review of the policy language and verify logs are writable to tenant logs.
Maya (Product): Thanks all. Ping me for the demo link or if you want to join the pilot. :wave:
